wpi_intro: Upload your WordPress XML export file to import posts, pages, categories, tags and SEO metadata into Synaptik CMS.
wpi_export_help: In WordPress, go to Tools → Export, choose "All content" and download the XML file.
wpi_overwrite: Overwrite existing items with the same URL slug
wpi_redirects_help: Create 301 redirects from old WordPress URLs to new Synaptik CMS URLs (requires the Redirects plugin)
wpi_images_notice: Images are not downloaded automatically. Your content will retain the original WordPress image URLs. Re-upload them via the File Manager and update the links manually, or keep the external URLs if the images remain accessible.
wpi_csrf_error: Security validation failed. Please go back and try again.
wpi_invalid_type: Invalid file type. Please upload a WordPress XML export file (.xml).
wpi_next_steps: Next steps: review your imported content, re-upload images via the File Manager, and check your redirects if the Redirects plugin is active.
